about.title: About Arou
about.historyPara1: Arou Tea Trail is located in the northern mountains of Taiwan, with over a century of tea cultivation history. Early settlers developed the area, taking advantage of the unique climate and soil conditions to grow high-quality tea. As times changed, local residents worked to preserve traditional tea-making crafts while incorporating modern innovations, allowing Arou tea culture to continue and flourish.
about.historyPara2: The trail preserves many historical sites, including ancient stone steps, traditional tea factories, and traces of early settlers' lives, making it an important venue for understanding the development of Taiwan's tea culture.
about.clickHint: Click to view the location of ancient stone steps on the map
about.naturePara1: The Arou trail environment is diverse, from low-altitude tea gardens to high-altitude primary forests, nurturing a rich ecosystem. This is home to many species of birds, insects, and plants, presenting different scenery throughout the four seasons.
about.forestClickHint: Click to view the forest adventure area on the map
about.naturePara2: In spring, tea flowers bloom; in summer, lush greenery abounds; in autumn, maple leaves turn red; and in winter, there are spectacular cloud seas. There are many ecological interpretation signs along the way, allowing visitors to increase their understanding and respect for nature while hiking.
about.experiencePara: Arou Tea Trail offers diverse experiences, from tea picking and tea-making crafts to tea tasting, allowing visitors to deeply understand the complete process of tea from planting to drinking. In addition, the trail regularly holds cultural lectures, art exhibitions, and seasonal activities to enrich visitors' travel experiences.
about.teaClickHint: Click to view the tea workshop location on the map
about.communityPara1: The maintenance and development of Arou Tea Trail cannot be separated from the joint efforts of local community residents. In recent years, with the assistance of government and private organizations, residents have actively participated in trail renovation, guide training, and cultural activities, giving this century-old trail new life.
about.communityPara2: Through community building, not only has the quality of life of local residents been improved, but it has also created a richer, more in-depth travel experience for visitors. Every visitor to Arou can feel the enthusiasm of the residents and their pride in this land.
about.hoursDetail: Open all year, recommended to visit from sunrise to sunset
about.publicTransport: Public transportation: Take the bus to Arou station, 10 minutes walk to reach
about.drivingInfo: Self-driving: Navigate to 'Arou Tea Culture Trail Visitor Center', free parking available
about.notice1: Please bring your own water and sun protection
about.notice3: Please take your trash with you when leaving the trail

themes.title: Explore by Theme
themes.teaDescription: Explore century-old tea gardens and taste the unique charm of Arou tea culture, experience traditional tea-making crafts.
themes.hikingDescription: Challenge yourself and feel the beauty of the mountains and the cleansing of body and mind, with various difficulty levels of hiking routes.
themes.storyDescription: Gain a deeper understanding of Arou's history, culture, and local stories, visit historical sites and centers of faith.
themes.familyDescription: Easy trails suitable for the whole family, the best choice for nature education, an outdoor playground for children.
